20064.long_desc: The top control panel multi insert instruction panel is designed to use the Arcooda square insert panels, allowing you to setup your machine to your gaming needs. This is an exclusive product for the Game Wizard Xtreme arcade machine. Choose from a number of square insert panels to customise your top control panel. As new square inserts are released, simply unscrew the existing square insert and install the new panel. Choose from USB multimedia and volume inserts to custom products. This top control panel also included a player instruction panel that is illuminated by LED lighting, and protected with glass panel. The Arcooda Game Wizard Xtreme series offers a modular design allowing you to change the top control panel as your gaming and store operations change. This is an exclusive product for Game Wizard Xtreme 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0 machine owners. Please Note: The 3 internal square inserts are not included.
